lane: قهنب قهنبان قَهْنَبَانٌ : see what follows. قَهَنَّبٌ Tall, and having a curving back, the upper part bending forward over the breast, or a bent and humped back, or a projecting breast and hollow back; accord. to the different explanations of أَجْنَأُ: or tall; (K;) i. e., in an absolute sense; (TA;) as also ↓قَهْنَبَانٌ. (K.) But AHei and others assert that the ن is augmentative. (MF.) مقهنب مُقَهْنِبٌ Always remaining at the water. (K.)

entries.text: القهنب، كشمردل: الطويل الأجنأ، أو الطويل، كالقهنبان. والمقهنب: الدائم على الماء.
